The lane may PROVE a sealed market package FAST_DATA_ONLY_RELEASE_ELIGIBLE = YES, but a Regression V2 plan may replace the broad regression with that proof only when FAST_PATH_PRODUCTION_ACTIVATION is ENABLED and the package's market is in pilot_allowlist. Until ATLAS-THROUGHPUT-004/005 integrate the artifact and release lifecycle, both stay closed: the fast path cannot silently replace the production deployment workflow.
